ai.seo_question: What is the characteristic behavior of the disbelievers according to Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Infitar, this verse contrasts the cosmic signs of the Day of Judgment with the stubborn denial of the disbelievers, a theme emphasized by Shia exegetes like Al-Tabarsi as a response to those who dismiss divine revelation despite clear evidence. The active nature of their 'kudhb' (lying/denying) underscores a spiritual blindness that persists even when the heavens are split open, serving as a warning for the faithful to remain steadfast in recognizing the truth.
